verdict: Yes. Rubans pitched artificial jewellery sets on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal, with one of the larger revenue figures in the dataset. Fashion jewellery is high-margin and light to ship, but copies appear fast, so quick design cycles matter.
angle: Brides, wedding guests and festival buyers want jewellery that looks expensive without the gold price. Mumbai, Rajkot and Delhi have large fashion jewellery manufacturing bases. Instagram and live selling are strong channels.
